consequence.statement: Environments running 1.17.0 gain the new metric cilium_policy_selector_match_count_max in the agent's metrics output; the upgrade note lists it only as an added metric, stating no removal, rename or change to existing behavior, so there is no operational consequence beyond new observability.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds the metric cilium_policy_selector_match_count_max, listed in the 1.17 upgrade notes under "Added Metrics".
